How this portfolio was made.

A personal garden, built one layer at a time.

The full process account now lives alongside the projects: the personal references, two-mode structure, map iterations, movement decisions and performance trade-offs.

Read the portfolio process

Authorship and assets

Lakshya directs the portfolio’s concept and design, supplies its personal stories and reviews each layer. Implementation and code checks are AI-assisted. Local checks are documented development evidence, not a completed user study or a guarantee of performance on every device.

  • Rendering: Three.js. Its MIT licence is retained with the local library distribution.
  • Woody model: the user-supplied ts3_woody (1).glb. Woody and Toy Story are existing characters and creative works; this portfolio does not claim their authorship.
  • Japanese Bridge Garden by kristenlee, under CC BY 4.0. Bridge geometry is extracted, resized and reshaped for the two crossings; the source display garden is omitted.
  • Low Poly Trees & Nature Pack by anastasita.3d, under CC BY 4.0. Selected trees, shrubs and stones are resized, grounded, rotated and instanced; the original texture atlas is retained.
  • Pokémon models: imported models have separate source, creator and licence records. Their detailed attribution is available below.
  • Typography: Mochiy Pop P One and DM Sans. The Mochiy Pop P One SIL Open Font License record is retained with the local font assets.
